items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had him on this session.

ctx.x: Calvin Shields, drums. Oh, Eagle Eye. Eagle Eye Shields, a very fine drummer. Played with Lionel Hampton and stayed around Indianapolis most of the time. We had him on this session.
